verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents resolving alerts through case decisions such as 'no risk detected', which covers a false-positive resolution. Cases and alerts can be remediated in the Mesh web app or via the API, and an endpoint returns the audit log trail for a case. The evidence never shows reopening a closed case or overriding a prior decision, so the reopen/override half of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: documented reopen/override of a resolved case or decision, explicit confirmation that decision changes are captured in the audit trail, independent or hands-on corroboration.
